europe_now.title: Denmark Exposes Russian Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: Denmark has accused Russia of coordinating an assassination plot and subsequently expelled a diplomat. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen condemned the plot as unacceptable and stated that Russian threats are becoming increasingly less hybrid.

sources.headline: Russian threats ‘less and less hybrid,’ Von der Leyen says after assassination plot in Denmark
'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen

europe_now.title: Drone Attack Damages Russian Ship in Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russian cargo ship was set ablaze following a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland. Both Helsinki and Moscow confirmed the incident, which has heightened regional security concerns.

sources.headline: Russian ship damaged by drone attack in Gulf of Finland, Helsinki and Moscow say
Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland

top_stories.title: EU and UK Finalize Post-Brexit Accord
top_stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have reached a reset deal regarding their post-Brexit relations. The new agreement outlines the framework for future diplomatic and economic engagement between the two sides.

sources.headline: EU, UK reach reset deal after Brexit
What the new UK-EU deal could mean for future post-Brexit relations

top_stories.title: French Parliament Adopts Police Shootings Legislation
top_stories.summary: The French parliament has adopted a controversial new law regarding police shootings that establishes a presumption of legitimate self-defense. Critics and activists have strongly denounced the legislation as a licence to kill.

sources.headline: 'Licence to kill': French parliament adopts police shootings law slammed by activists
